correctness.rationale: Cauchy brightness for 24 equal octahedral facets yields B(u)=2/3(3a+2b+c) for ordered absolute coordinates, equivalently bmax times the maximum of 192 signed-permutation orbit dot products. Independent exact integer enumeration finds 192 centers, 384 pairs at dot 13/14 (degree four) and all other pairs at most 12/14. The degree-four nearest graph is triangle-free; hence in s≥sqrt(13/14) no triple cap intersection of positive measure and only nearest pairs can overlap below h=sqrt(27/28). Haar S3 cap probability is P(s). Pair-cap intersection integrates over a uniformly distributed 2-disk to L(s) with Y=h sqrt(1−s²)−qs. Inclusion–exclusion gives exactly 192P−384L on b2≤b≤bmax. Expanding the lens at first tangency gives quadratic coefficient 192sqrt3/π, and therefore a C1/not-C2 transition at b1=√6. Independent rational orbit enumeration and lens-limit checks confirm, not replace the geometric integration proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Novaga–Song classify 24-cell isoperimetric extremality, not distribution of random shadows. General Cauchy projection and spherical-cap integration formulas do not enumerate which of the 192 caps overlap, nor the first lens transition.
